what: New Makefile-only harness is not added to agent-lint exclusions
scenario_or_breakage: agent-lint does not follow Makefile-only references, so scripts/test-render-final-summary-bash32.sh can be flagged as dead even though the Makefile target is wired
suggested_fix: Add scripts/test-render-final-summary-bash32.sh to agent-lint.toml beside the test-collect-agent-bash32 precedent

what: Proposed dynamic test checks the wrong stderr surface
scenario_or_breakage: The nounset failure inside invoke_render is redirected to DESIGN_TMPDIR/render-final-summary.stderr.log, then fallback can still produce rc=0 and a non-empty final-summary.md, so Case 2 can pass while the runtime bug fired
suggested_fix: Have Case 2 also assert DESIGN_TMPDIR/render-final-summary.stderr.log and execution-issues.md do not contain unbound variable or a render-run-summary fallback warning

what: Proposed harness invocation does not clear ISSUE_NUMBER
scenario_or_breakage: A developer running the harness from an issue-bound environment can trigger tracking-issue-summary.sh upsert-summary during --post-publish-only and mutate GitHub comments from a regression test
suggested_fix: Invoke the subject with ISSUE_NUMBER="" and a test SESSION_ID, plus explicit DESIGN_TMPDIR and CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT, so the harness is hermetic
